 Tiger Shroff Returns To Instagram After Mumbai Firing Incident With Tenu Leke Jaana Teaser; Watch Video!
 Mahi Pillai | 17.NOV.2026 Link copied to clipboard 
 Tiger Shroff has finally shared a new post on Instagram after staying away from social media for almost a month. The actor posted a teaser of his upcoming song, Tenu Leke Jaana , on Monday. This is his first post since the October 18 firing incident in Mumbai, when unidentified men opened fire at a car carrying him and his driver. Before the incident, Tiger Shroff had shared a video promoting his perfume brand. He had not posted anything on his social media accounts since then.
 Tiger Shroff Returns To Instagram With Tenu Leke Jaana Teaser After Mumbai Firing Incident
 The new teaser features Tiger Shroff in a black tuxedo. He shows off his physique and dance moves. He is also seen sharing romantic moments with Ketika Sharma in the song. Sharing the video, the actor wrote, “One more chance, one more dance.” His sister, Krishna Shroff, was among the first to react to the post. She dropped a fire emoji and also commented, “He is back.” Several fans welcomed the actor back on Instagram. One user wrote, “Our hero is back.” Another commented, “Really! Seeing you on my feed after so long makes me happy, Tiger Bhai! Welcome, champion!” A third user wrote, “Tiger 2.0 version loaded.” Tenu Leke Jaana will be released on November 18, 2026, under the T-Series banner. The track is a recreated version of Tennu Le , which was originally part of the 2009 film Jai Veeru . The original song was sung by Omer Inayat and featured Kunal Kemmu and Anjana Sukhani.

 Tiger Shroff Resumes Shooting After Firing Incident
 Tiger Shroff has also returned to work following the incident. As reported by Hindustan Times , the actor recently completed a four-day song shoot with Janhvi Kapoor in Pune for Raj Mehta’s upcoming film, Lag Jaa Gale . The shoot took place at a pub in Kalyani Nagar, and the dance number was choreographed by Bosco Martis . A source from the set told the publication that Tiger Shroff, who was sporting a blonde look, also clicked pictures with dancers and staff members between shots. However, security around the actor reportedly remains tight. His team members and associates have been asked to sign non-disclosure agreements (NDAs) and avoid sharing details about his location and shooting schedules.
 About Tiger Shroff’s Firing Incident
 On October 18, unidentified motorcycle-borne assailants opened fire at a car carrying Tiger Shroff and his driver in Mumbai’s Juhu area. The actor was returning from a football ground when the incident took place. While Tiger Shroff escaped unhurt, his driver sustained a bullet injury to his hand. A fan standing nearby was also injured. The Mumbai Police launched an investigation. Reports stated that 14 people had been arrested in connection with the case.
